## Working papers

### Latent-State Conformal Prediction for Synthetic Controls

**Andrew Wang** · In progress

I develop conformal prediction sets for synthetic control counterfactuals under latent regime shifts. The project combines hidden Markov models and block conformal inference, with simulations in Python and R using PyTorch.

[Project: ConformalHMM](conformalhmm.html) · [Code](https://github.com/yuanzhouwang/ConformalHMM)

### A State-Switching Model of Political Unrest

**Andrew Wang** · Presented at MPSA 2026 and APSA 2025

This paper develops a game-theoretic model of the reciprocal dynamics of protest and state repression. Ongoing work designs a hidden Markov model to learn protest-repression state-switching dynamics.

### Strategic Complementarity: Explaining Economic Growth in China's Frontier Regions

**Andrew Wang** · Presented at MPSA 2026

I examine how political insecurity and state institutions shape divergent industrial development across Xinjiang, Tibet, and Inner Mongolia. The project combines a game-theoretic explanation with historical fiscal, industrial, and employment data and a triple-differences research design.

### Foreign Political Integration: Chinese Sponsorship Reduces Renegotiation Hazard for Pakistani IPPs

**Andrew Wang and Hassan Aziz** · First author · Accepted at APSA 2026

We study whether Chinese-sponsored independent power producers receive more stable contracts from the Pakistani government, using original project-level data and proportional hazards models in R.

[Project: IPPs](ipps.html) · [Code and data](https://github.com/yuanzhouwang/ipps)
